stories.title: At least 2 killed, 2 others injured in Third Ward shooting, Houston police say
stories.summary: Houston police said two people were shot and killed, and two others were taken to local hospitals with unknown injuries.

stories.title: Deaths of two girls under investigation in north Harris County
stories.summary: Harris County detectives are investigating the deaths of two girls after responding to a home and an emergency clinic in north Harris County.

stories.title: Chlorine detected outside Lubrizol facility in Deer Park; officials say no threat
stories.summary: Minor traces of chlorine were detected outside Lubrizol's Deer Park facility following a chemical incident.

stories.title: Here's what a U.S. Space Academy in Houston could look like under Texas' official proposal | See the renderings
stories.summary: Texas has officially proposed Houston as the home of the U.S. Space Academy, which could begin educating its first 300 students in 2028.

stories.title: 'Help us bring her home' | Family of missing Kountze woman asks hunters to watch for clues
stories.summary: Julia Carter, 46, disappeared from Kountze in October. Her family hopes hunters and landowners can help bring her home.

stories.title: Houston man learns sentence for creating, distributing ISIS propaganda
stories.summary: The FBI arrested Said in November 2024, saying he had bragged that he would commit a "9/11-style attack," and worked with ISIS in a plot to kill a former president.

stories.title: Katy Freeway reopens at Fry after pedestrian reportedly hit, killed by car
stories.summary: Details surrounding the crash are limited.

stories.title: How a former Tomball ISD employee stole nearly $1 million in property tax payments
stories.summary: A former Tomball ISD tax office manager admits to stealing nearly $1 million in property tax payments and could face up to 20 years in prison.

stories.title: Pickup truck, e-scooter burst into flames after serious crash in Sunnyside area
stories.summary: A critical e-scooter accident in Houston sparks renewed safety concerns as electric vehicles' injury rates climb, with health experts urging safety measures.

stories.title: Child killed in Fort Bend County e-bike crash as safety concerns grow
stories.summary: A deadly Fort Bend County e-bike crash comes as a Houston hospital reports rising injuries and experts urge parents to consider safety before buying.

stories.title: Residents picking up the pieces after apartment fire in west Houston
stories.summary: One man said that while he's grateful he and his family made it out safe, he's upset they lost everything in the fire.

stories.title: Family remembers Houston couple with ties to trail ride community
stories.summary: Calvin Richard Jr., 81, and his wife, Arlene, 65, were found dead in a Houston house fire on Monday. Their family is grieving days before Thanksgiving.
